title: Calculate
summary: Exact decimal arithmetic on an expression.

sections.use: Do arithmetic exactly instead of asking a model: numbers, + - * /, unary minus and parentheses.
sections.exclusions: No functions, powers, percentages or variables.
sections.limitations: Exact decimal arithmetic to 34 significant digits; rounded is true when the result was rounded. Expressions up to 500 characters.
sections.missing_data: An empty or invalid expression is refused as syntax_error.
sections.effects: Runs locally inside AgentWiz with no network access, files or model; it only returns a value. It has no destination, so it can run on Local only data; its output is restricted whenever an input is.
sections.failures: A refusal names a fixed code and, where it applies, a 1-based position (record, row or entry); the message never repeats your text. Check the input against the limits above and run again.

outputs.out: The result as a decimal string and rounded.
